'''Spiny Toad''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Hive}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Spiny Toad}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Protruding Spikes
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 5 {{BD2|Thorns}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Thorns
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Spike Explosion
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (23;{{Asc2|9|25}}) damage. Loses 5 {{BD2|Thorns}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Thorns
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Tongue Lash
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (17;{{Asc2|9|19}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Cycles through {{Int2|Spiny Toad|Protruding Spikes}}, {{Int2|Spiny Toad|Spike Explosion}}, {{Int2|Spiny Toad|Tongue Lash}} in order, repeating.

== Animations ==
{{Bestiary|Spiny Toad}}

== Trivia ==
* The '''Spiny Toad''' appears to be the adult form of a {{M2|Toadpole}}, as they share very similar mechanics and near identical color palettes.
